record: roadmap D: the size of a correlated oscillator residual in the four-outcome servo likelihood
status: DRAFT (D1): prepared for review, not frozen. No correlated design-point check, pilot or outcome run may execute against a draft.
claim: C14 (pilot). D revises its appendix scope only; D gates no freeze.

model.phase: point-sampled Gaussian AR(1): x_n = rho x_{n-1} + sqrt(1-rho^2) sigma xi_n, xi ~ N(0,1)
model.latent_state: unwrapped x on a truncated real grid; the wrapped phase is not a Markov lumping of it, since x and x + 2 pi have next-step means differing by 2 pi rho
model.initialisation: the left eigenvector of the discretised transition, not the continuous N(0, sigma^2)
model.emission: P(B1,B2 | x, eps) = (1 + B1 C1 cos(x+ph1))(1 + B2 C2 cos(x+eps+ph2))/4, C1 = C2 = 0.9
model.signal: white Gaussian modulation of variance 0.09. The likelihood uses its exact marginal, C2 -> C2 exp(-0.045), because the simulator draws the continuous Gaussian; sid_run7's 41-point truncated sum is a different law, kept in the baseline, and its deterministic difference is recorded per point and reported separately
model.offsets: frozen by index; the slope optimum is unique, the variance optimum is fourfold degenerate to about 1e-13, so a run-time argmax would choose by roundoff
model.tie_rule: among offsets within 1e-09 relative of the maximum, the lowest index in the declared grid order is selected
model.records: paired across rho and across the two hypotheses by common random numbers

records.estimation: the retained observations follow the warm-up; warm-up observations are filtered and excluded from every estimator

K5.marginal_match: exp(-sigma^2/2) = I1(kappa)/I0(kappa), the von Mises first circular moment

K10.marginal_match: exp(-sigma^2/2) = I1(kappa)/I0(kappa), the von Mises first circular moment

rng.streams: one generator per (phase, design point, record); seed = phase base + 100 x seed_block + record index, as stored in each point's seeds block
rng.draw_order: x_0 = standard_normal() * sigma; then per block of 65536 shots: the phase innovations, then the signal modulation, then one uniform per shot
rng.hypothesis_independence: the modulation is drawn under both hypotheses and multiplied by zero when unmodulated, so the stream does not depend on the hypothesis
rng.prefixes: records from one seed agree on complete blocks only; every phase regenerates at its frozen length and never relies on a prefix of a longer record

estimands.slope: C_eff,slope = sqrt(J), J the Fisher-information rate, estimated by the conditional-information average along the filtered history
estimands.variance: C_eff,var solves I_ext_exact(C_eff, 0.3) = D, D the KL rate from two filters
estimands.score: the total score S_N is retained for derivative checks only; S_N^2/N is not an estimator here, its per-record variance does not shrink with N

ND1a_fisher_nesting.requirement: the conditional-information estimator equals the single-shot Fisher information under the same discretised marginal

ND1b_kl_nesting.requirement: per-shot increments equal the i.i.d. log-likelihood ratios, and the sampled mean agrees with the analytic i.i.d. KL within sampling uncertainty
ND1b_kl_nesting.sampling: the KL average fluctuates; it does not nest exactly

ND2_grid.requirement: J and D are stable from the base grid to each refinement
ND2_grid.aggregation: the maximum relative change over records, refinements and channels

ND3_brute_force.requirement: at rho > 0 the summed increments of the production kl_rate filter equal the brute-force log-likelihood difference over latent grid paths, and replacing correlated filtering with stationary-marginal i.i.d. marginalisation is rejected

ND4_score.requirement: the analytic tangent matches central differences, and the normalisation without the quotient-rule term is rejected
ND4_score.near_zero: if the reference score is below 1e-12 in absolute value the comparison is absolute at 1e-12, not relative

ND5_simulator.requirement: stationary variance, lag-one correlation and first circular moment reproduce their targets
ND5_simulator.effective_sample_size: N_eff = N (1 - rho^2)/(1 + rho^2): the draws are correlated and an i.i.d. standard error would be too small
ND5_simulator.aggregation: every check record must satisfy |statistic - target| <= 6 SE, and the mean over the check records must satisfy the same bound with SE/sqrt(replicates)

ND6_marginal.requirement: the von Mises baseline at rho = 0 against the Gaussian baseline at rho = 0, reported separately as the marginal effect, never as correlation

ND7_burn_in.requirement: warm-ups of W and 2W observations are compared on the SAME final estimation window, for the filter, the tangent and both KL filters
ND7_burn_in.window: the last `retained` observations of a record of 2W + retained observations
ND7_burn_in.aggregation: the maximum relative change over records and channels

ND8_signal_law.requirement: the deterministic difference between the analytic Gaussian marginal and sid_run7's 41-point truncated sum is computed and reported per point

numerical_checks.failure: a failed check blocks the outcome; these criteria are frozen before the checks run

inputs: the ND2 aggregated relative change in J and in D
the grid residual of J(0) itself, measured the same way
allowance.nature: adopted numerical allowances, taken from refinement differences; they are not certified error bounds
allowance.units: absolute rate units: each relative residual multiplies the rate it belongs to, the numerator residuals J_hat(rho) and the denominator residuals J(0)
allowance.combination: summed within each side, not added in quadrature; numerator and denominator allowances stay separate
allowance.application: propagated through the ratio before the absolute image is taken: lo = sqrt((J_lo - e_rho)/(J0 + e_0)) - 1 and hi = sqrt((J_hi + e_rho)/(J0 - e_0)) - 1. Widening the absolute interval by half the relative residual is first order at the reference only, and can declare a case the exact transformation leaves open
allowance.nonpositive: if a permitted numerator or denominator is not positive, the ratio is not formed and the point is UNRESOLVED
allowance.sizing_only: the first-order form, 0.5 x the summed relative residuals in ratio units, is used in the sizing rule and never in classification
allowance.exhaustion: if the allowance alone reaches kappa_D x tolerance (0.005) the point is UNRESOLVED_NUMERICAL and is not evaluated

sizing_rule.pilot_statistic: s^2, the across-record variance of J_hat over the pilot's records; no mean, no ratio and no per-record value is recorded
sizing_rule.extrapolation: the estimator averages N shots, so Var(J_hat) scales as 1/N: U(N) = U x (pilot retained / N)
sizing_rule.reference: J(0), deterministic and known before the pilot; the pilot records no mean, so no measured interval centre enters the sizing
sizing_rule.half_width: h(N) = t_0975_df15 x sqrt(U(N)/R) / (2 J(0)), the delta method at the reference
sizing_rule.requirement: h(N) + the first-order sizing allowance <= kappa_D x tolerance; sizing may use that approximation, classification may not
sizing_rule.solve: N >= pilot_retained x U x t_0975_df15^2 / (4 R J(0)^2 (kappa_D x tolerance - allowance)^2)
sizing_rule.rounding: round N up to a multiple of 10000, and never below the evaluation minimum
sizing_rule.replicates: R is fixed at 16 for this protocol: the sixteen evaluation seeds and the df = 15 quantile are frozen for that R and a larger R would need both reissued
refusals: allowance >= kappa_D x tolerance: UNRESOLVED_NUMERICAL, no run
predicted cost above the point ceiling or the remaining aggregate: NOT_ATTEMPTED
no shortened records, no replacement records, no top-ups
sizing_rule.predicted_versus_guaranteed: this sizes for a predicted half-width; the realised interval decides the verdict. A realised half-width above target is reported as it stands and never repaired by further records

uncertainty.interval: t_0975_df15 on J_hat(rho) across the 16 paired records
uncertainty.denominator: J(0) computed directly and deterministically under the matched marginal, not a second Monte-Carlo estimate; the driver recomputes it on the frozen grid and must reproduce J0_reference to 1e-9 relative
uncertainty.transform: g(J) = sqrt(J/J(0)) - 1, monotone, endpoint to endpoint
uncertainty.absolute_image: a signed interval containing 0 maps to [0, max(|lo|,|hi|)]; otherwise [min(|lo|,|hi|), max(|lo|,|hi|)]
uncertainty.numerical_allowance: see the allowance block: the adopted allowances, including J(0)'s own residual, are propagated through the ratio and the verdict must survive them. Passing a convergence threshold does not settle a result near the tolerance, and halving the residual is not enough to decide one.
uncertainty.nonpositive: if the lower bound of J_hat(rho) is <= 0 the ratio is not formed: UNRESOLVED

rule: BELOW if the widened absolute interval lies wholly below the tolerance
ABOVE if it lies wholly above
UNRESOLVED if it straddles the tolerance, touches it, or the numerical allowance cannot be met
NO_VERDICT if a check failed, the point was not attempted, or the run was INCOMPLETE
classification.variance_channel: reported separately with its own interval
classification.channel_agreement: a further statistic, never the change-from-independence criterion

execution.stack: the sid-f environment of roadmap F: analysis/stack_F/conda-osx-arm64.txt with its committed lock records analysis/stack_F/conda-osx-arm64.lock, conda-list.json, pip-lock.txt and stack-record.json
execution.deadline_accounting: wall-clock seconds are recorded per phase in its res15 artifact; each run reads the remaining aggregate from those records before it starts, and every run counts once however many artifacts it writes
execution.admission: a phase starts only if its predicted cost fits the phase ceiling and the remaining aggregate; a point whose prediction exceeds the point ceiling is NOT_ATTEMPTED
execution.runtime_stop: a phase stops at its start plus the minimum of the applicable ceiling (checks, pilot or point) and the remaining aggregate budget. The deadline covers setup, simulation and filtering alike, and a run that reaches it is INCOMPLETE with NO_VERDICT: it is never completed by shortening records
execution.cost_prediction: charged per propagation over every shot the phase runs, warm-ups included. The Fisher pass costs two propagations, the filter and its tangent, and the KL pass two, one filter per hypothesis: R x (warm_up + retained) x 4 propagation-shots, times the pilot's measured seconds per propagation-shot, times a margin of 1.1
execution.interruption: artifacts are written before any computation and checkpointed after every step; an interrupted or stopped run keeps its elapsed time, is INCOMPLETE and receives NO_VERDICT. An unaffordable or interrupted calculation never acquires a verdict through shortened or replacement records
execution.provenance: git revision and tree state, python, numpy and scipy versions, platform and machine, libblas build, the five thread variables and this protocol's digest, recorded at the start of every phase
execution.refusal: a draft status or digest mismatch, a dirty tree, an existing output for the phase, a stack outside the pins, or any thread variable other than 1

budget.cost_note: R N M^2 is 2.097152e11 matrix terms for one propagation per shot at R = 16, N = 2e5, M = 256; the score adds a propagation and the KL channel runs two filters. D1 measures the real cost before any sizing is applied.
budget.ceilings_are_not_authorisation: these bound a run that has been approved; they neither authorise execution nor promise completion
